Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Black and White Winding Road in Snow Print Wall Art Decor - 18 x 22 Inch Frame, Silver
Colors: Black
Materials: Paper
An empty road winds through snow-covered woods in this black and white aerial photo. Stark contrast and interesting shapes give this photo the look of abstract art. It is handsomely matted in a silver frame to add the perfect modern touch to your home. 22"W x18"H Photo print on paper with silver frame Modern photo print Ready to hang, all hardware included
